environment.renderer: Software Mesa through an isolated Xephyr X server; unmodified official client
environment.authentication: Normal /register followed by normal /login after a complete server and client restart

observations.actions: Reconnect with the required pack, /login, then /phone without using /pack
observations.observed: Dark/gold custom phone frame and all home app icons and side shortcuts render; no magenta missing textures.

observations.actions: Click the JEEVA side shortcut from the phone
observations.observed: Styled JEEVA menu opens with service and help actions. This verifies the local graphical guide, not an external LLM integration.

observations.actions: /gun; inspect the first page; select starter Kavach in the hotbar
observations.observed: Distinct native firearm models appear on the first equipment page, and the equipped Kavach renders in first person.

observations.actions: Normal registration, full server/client shutdown and restart, normal login
observations.observed: Exactly one native Kavach and the original 32 matching reserve rounds remained before any shots. No second repair grant occurred.

observations.actions: Right-click Kavach while inside the configured spawn safe zone
observations.observed: Combat is disabled in this safe area; magazine was not consumed.

observations.check: Native firing and matching ammunition reload
observations.actions: Walk normally outside the inspected 18-block spawn safe zone; right-click; sneak and right-click; inspect the inventory tooltip
observations.observed: The first shot displayed Kavach 9mm Compact 11/12. After reload, tooltip displayed Charge 12/12 and reserve ammunition was 30. The held modifier/click sequence produced one additional shot before sneaking reached the server, so the sequence consumed two rounds.

observations.check: Owned vehicle access and wheel rendering
observations.actions: /car, select the owned starter rickshaw, inspect front and rear third-person views
observations.observed: Garage entry mounts the owned rickshaw. The front wheel remains below the body at ground level, including after wheel rotation; no orbit above the roof was observed.

observations.actions: W for 1.8 seconds; W+D for 1.8 seconds; Space brake; S reverse; Space brake; Shift exit
observations.observed: Forward acceleration displayed 14 km/h, moving steering displayed 15 km/h, reverse displayed 9 km/h, braking displayed 0 km/h, and safe dismount worked. Fuel decreased to 99%; body remained 100%.

The earlier tested pack produced zero missing-model-texture warnings and zero duplicate-sprite warnings. One inherited unused malformed phantom_membrane_org JSON was identified in that pack; the later final_pack_smoke below verifies its repaired replacement without attributing earlier gameplay checks to the final bytes.

scope_limits: Java 26.3 desktop client only; no Bedrock client session.
Isolated local staging world only; no live Daytona or production deployment.
No claim of comprehensive slope, curb, high-speed collision, multiplayer latency or vehicle roster testing.
No audio acceptance: the isolated client environment has no OpenAL output device and only visual assets were fully downloaded.
No damage-balancing or combat-target accuracy claim from this UI smoke test.

The final build smoke rechecked normal-login phone rendering, the native equipment catalogue, mounted rickshaw canopy clearance and pack loading. Earlier firing, reload and driving observations retain their separate tested_artifacts hashes above; those full sequences were not repeated after the targeted canopy and unused-JSON changes.

final_pack_smoke.session: Normal client reconnect and /login following a graceful staging-server restart with the final core and required Java pack.

observations.observed: The custom dark/gold phone frame, all 24 home app icons and the side shortcuts render without magenta missing textures.

observations.actions: /gun; inspect first page; move the pointer away from item slots
observations.observed: Distinct functional native firearms appear first, with matching ammunition and navigation icons rendered. Final capture has no tooltip obscuring the catalogue.

observations.actions: /car; select the existing owned starter rickshaw; inspect the mounted rear/side third-person view; dismount normally
observations.observed: The driver head remains beneath the raised canopy. Wheel geometry stays below the body and at ground level. The stationary HUD shows 0 km/h, fuel 99%, body 100%. This checks the targeted clearance correction; the earlier driving sequence was not repeated.

resource_reload_audit.scope: Only the final server-pack reload at 15:02:36 UTC until the vanilla reload on disconnect at 15:08:51 UTC. Earlier pack attempts and later disconnected title-menu Realms requests are excluded.
resource_reload_audit.other_errors: One SoundSystem startup error because the isolated environment has no OpenAL output device; audio is outside acceptance scope.
